name: Morgenröte
source:
A young woman who awakens in a strange mansion without any memory of how she got there or who she is.
A weary man named Dämmerung claims to be caring for her, but can he truly be trusted?
The more fragments Morgen regains of her mind, the more determined she becomes.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/dawnofthedamned]Itch.io[/url]]
